### Historical audit: H0086

**Scope.** This is chunk 3 of 3 of a student trace; earlier chunks are not visible. The apparent goal—persisting a training feature schema and enforcing it on later inputs—is inferred from the task name and implementation, not from a visible original task prompt. This is a software task, not a Scene task.

All event citations below refer to H0086, original file `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/hint-codex-experiments/runs/codex_parallel_08/lanes/codex_parallel_08_lane1/codex_parallel_08_lane1_H_r1/infer_logs/igel-persist-feature-schema/turn_1/trajs.json`, `main_agent`.

| Evidence | Observation and limits |
|---|---|
| Exploration | The student inspected fit/export tests and mock arguments, attempted to read a nonexistent `conftest.py`, and launched pytest from alternative working directories (events 82, 86, 88–92). These are observed student operations; their independence from unseen guidance cannot be established. |
| Implementation | The reviewed diff implements ordered feature selection, constant/duplicate dropping, alias consistency checks, schema persistence and loading, fitted scaling/imputation, and API validation; export uses training input width (event 122). Later successful edits changed schema-path precedence, export error propagation, and duplicate comparison (events 124, 128, 130). A separate identical-text edit made no change (event 96); the overall patch was not empty. |
| Validation | Imports succeeded and a schema artifact was listed (event 108). A later background regression run was launched (events 109–110), but its visible output was only `.` when read (event 126), not a completed test summary. The student claimed existing tests and an alias/order check passed (event 133); those claims are not independently demonstrated in this visible chunk. |
| Completion | A commit succeeded with four changed files, 184 insertions and 24 deletions, and clean branch status (event 132). Inventory metadata reports **partial correctness, formally not solved**: 23/24 fail-to-pass and 2/2 pass-to-pass. The failing case and evaluation output are not visible here. |
| Teacher input | The inventory lists available hint files and an after-round review, but this chunk contains no captured teacher text delivered to the student. Availability is not receipt; adoption and causal influence are unknown. The after-round review cannot be input to this round. |

**Lessons and uncertainty.** A transferable concern illustrated by the implementation is that fit-time preprocessing state and feature order must remain consistent at inference; task-specific handling includes duplicate aliases, API errors, and ONNX width. These are design observations, not proof of complete correctness. The cause of the one formal failure remains unresolved. In particular, whether the final path-precedence or duplicate-comparison edits affect that failure is only a hypothesis; no visible final test result establishes it.
